typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν) (c : ν → Nat),
  DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.Ok N →
    ∀ (L : Nat),
      (∀ (x : ν), Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N) x → LE.le.{0} (c x) L) →
        ∀ (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)),
          (∀ (a : Prod.{0, 0} ν ν),
              Membership.mem.{0, 0} U a → Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N) a) →
            LE.le.{0} (List.length.{0} U) (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N)) →
              ∀ (rls : List.{0} (List.{0} ν)) (y : ν),
                (∀ (Ly : List.{0} ν),
                    Membership.mem.{0, 0} rls Ly →
                      ∀ (x : ν),
                        Membership.mem.{0, 0} Ly x →
                          Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N) x) →
                  Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N) y →
                    LE.le.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.extractRC N c U rls y)
                      (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (List.length.{0} rls)) 1)
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (List.length.{0} (List.flatten.{0} rls))
                          (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 2 (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 L))
                            (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.resB
                              (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N)) L))))

source.code:
theorem extractRC_le (hN : N.Ok) (L : ℕ) (hL : ∀ x ∈ N.nodes, c x ≤ L) (U : List (ν × ν))
    (hU : ∀ a ∈ U, a ∈ N.arcs) (hm : U.length ≤ N.arcs.length) :
    ∀ (rls : List (List ν)) (y : ν), (∀ Ly ∈ rls, ∀ x ∈ Ly, x ∈ N.nodes) → y ∈ N.nodes →
      N.extractRC c U rls y ≤
        2 * rls.length + 1 + rls.flatten.length * (2 + 2 * L + resB N.arcs.length L)
  | [], y, _, _ => by simp [extractRC]
  | Ly :: rest, y, hr, hy => by
      simp only [extractRC, List.length_cons, List.flatten_cons, List.length_append]
      have h1 := N.memNC_le c L hL Ly y (hr Ly (by simp)) hy
      have hr' : ∀ L' ∈ rest, ∀ x ∈ L', x ∈ N.nodes :=
        fun L' hL' => hr L' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hL')
      split_ifs with hyL
      · have h2 := N.descendRC_le c hN L hL U hU hm rest y hr' hy
        nlinarith
      · have h2 := extractRC_le hN L hL U hU hm rest y hr' hy
        nlinarith
